title: Skills - Agent Skills Marketplace
description: Discover, install, inspect, and toggle AI Agent Skills (.agents/skills, skills.sh) with one click.

title: DXF Viewer & CAD Viewer for 2D Drawings
description: DXF viewer and CAD viewer that opens ASCII and binary .dxf drawings in VS Code with layers, pan, zoom, measure, blocks, text, dimensions and PNG or SVG export.

title: Multi-Git Explorer
description: See the branch and status of every git repository in your workspace at a glance, even with hundreds of repos.

title: JSON Viewer & JSON Tree
description: JSON viewer with a fast JSON tree for large files. Search keys and values, copy JSONPath, see arrays of objects as a table and open escaped JSON strings. Offline.

title: JSONL Viewer & NDJSON Table Viewer
description: Open JSONL and NDJSON files as a table, as pretty records or as a chat view for LLM datasets. Fast on large files, with search, filters and live tail. Offline.

title: Claude Code Usage & Codex Usage Cost Meter
description: See today's Claude Code and Codex tokens and estimated cost in the status bar, with the Claude Code 5-hour block, Codex rate limits and a 30-day dashboard. Offline. Not affiliated with Anthropic or OpenAI.

title: SQLite Table Viewer
description: Open SQLite databases (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) read-only. Browse tables with paging, see the schema, run SELECT queries, view JSON and BLOB cells and export CSV. Offline.

title: Video Preview with Sound
description: Play MP4, MOV, MKV and WebM files in VS Code with their sound, which VS Code mutes on its own. Frame step, speed, A-B loop and PNG frame grabs.

title: Spinbox
description: Open Spinbox workspaces in VS Code over Remote-SSH, through the spin CLI.

title: Agent Session Viewer
description: Browse, search and export your local Claude Code and Codex sessions, with prompts, replies, tool calls, file edits and token use. Read-only. Offline.

title: Route Atlas
description: See every page and endpoint of a web project in one sorted tree, then jump to the code, send requests and check them. Works with Flask, Next.js, Express, Django, Laravel and many more.
